records.text: In the recorded UN speech, Netanyahu said Israel had fought a seven-front war for three years against Hamas, Hezbollah, the Houthis, Iran, militias in Iraq and Syria, and Palestinian terrorists in Judea and Samaria, who he said had ganged up to wipe Israel off the face of the earth.
records.speaker: Benjamin Netanyahu

appearances.snippet: For the past three years. ... Our heroic soldiers have fought day in and day out ... in a seven-front war. ... other country the size of New Jersey capable ... fighting No. a seven-front war and ... for three years, seven ... fronts Hamas, Hezbollah, ... the Houthis, Iran, militias in Iraq, militias in Syria. Palestinian terrorists in Judea and Samaria, they all ganged ... up on us ... to wipe us off the face of the earth.
